name: ah-my-openresearch
description: Research laboratory with personas, skills, document control, and outside literature wiki for OpenCode/Codex/Claude Code.

scripts.build:plugin: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target node --format esm && chmod +x dist/cli/index.js
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun run build:plugin && bun run build:cli && bun run build:types && bun run generate:schema
scripts.generate:schema: bun run scripts/generate-schema.ts && biome format --write ah-my-openresearch.schema.json
